label: Diagram 9
caption: Diagram 9 Ventilator free areas | Permanently open air vents
description: Diagram 9, titled Ventilator free areas, has two parts. Part (a), captioned "Ventilator assembled on site from components", is a section through a wall (shown in hatching) with a vertical duct. Horizontal grille bars sit at the top and bottom of the duct. An unlabelled downward arrow points to the upper grille, and an upward arrow labelled "Duct area" points to the lower grille. Arrows labelled "Equivalent or Free area 1" and "Equivalent or Free area 2" point, from the left and right respectively, to the side openings at the top of the duct. Below, a note reads: "The ventilator area is the smaller of equivalent area (1 or 2) (as declared by manufacturer), free area (1 or 2) (as measured in (b)) or the duct area." Part (b), captioned "Measuring the free area of components on site", shows the components separately. On the left, slanted pieces are arranged in a vertical row with arrows marking the gaps labelled A1, A2 and A3; on the right, vertical pieces are shown with dimension lines also labelled A1, A2 and A3. Beneath this, the formula "Free area = A1 + A2 + A3" appears.
